restaurant_name: บ้านสี่ขารักษาสัตว์
text: I have been talking my dog and cats to this place for over 10 years. They are extremely knowledgeable, compassionate, and caring. The kind of helpful vet went above and beyond. Awesome clinic and friendly staff. Keep up the good work!

restaurant_name: บ้านสี่ขารักษาสัตว์
text: I had the opportunity to use the clinic's services to get my cat spayed. I left my cat there for two nights. When it was time to take him home, his wound was completely healed and he was as cheerful as ever. When it was time for the doctor's appointment to remove the stitches, there were no problems. The price was ok. 😊 …
author_name: ศศิมา มะโน

restaurant_name: บ้านสี่ขารักษาสัตว์
text:
I've been bringing my cats here for treatment for many years. Even though it's not a clinic near my house, it's one I trust. ❤️

One elderly stray cat was diagnosed with kidney disease and had tartar removed from its mouth. 😺

Two other cats have been here since they were kittens; one male was neutered. 😻😻 One of them was once bitten badly on the rear by an adult cat and survived until he was neutered.
author_name: ขนุนเฉาก๊วย

restaurant_name: บ้านสี่ขารักษาสัตว์
text: They took really good care of our children, and the medical costs were very affordable.

restaurant_name: บ้านสี่ขารักษาสัตว์
text: Terrible. They gave me IV fluids like they were giving IV fluids to a human. There was no advice or consultation whatsoever. They showed absolutely no willingness to provide treatment. Do you even know what proper medical treatment and service are? If not, please go back to school and learn how to treat people properly. (This isn't directed at everyone working here.)

restaurant_name: บ้านสี่ขารักษาสัตว์
text: This place is like a second home to my kids. They're always noisy when they're here! The staff are lovely to my kids. I highly recommend it!

restaurant_name: บ้านสี่ขารักษาสัตว์
text: My cat, who had leukemia, caught a recurring cold. When we took her to the vet, her condition was already very serious. The vet did an excellent job treating her, and now she's much better and almost recovered from the cold. I'm very impressed. The vet treated her honestly, didn't prolong the treatment unnecessarily, and the treatment costs weren't expensive. Most importantly, my cat is doing much better. Thank you, vet!

restaurant_name: บ้านสี่ขารักษาสัตว์
text: That day I took my kitten, who was less than 2 months old, to get dewormed, and it cost 240 baht. Was that too expensive? Other places charge less than 100 baht.

restaurant_name: บ้านสี่ขารักษาสัตว์
